candidates.severity: unassigned; source-established representable non-repeating-route policy violation, actual stored incidence unproved
candidates.classification: Rune authority validation does not enforce the no-repeated-gates policy that generation obeys.
candidates.trace: RuneTransformationSpec permits allow_repeated_route_gates=false when route_length does not exceed gate_count. Generation shuffles the distinct active gates and takes the requested length in that mode. The public serializable RuneTransformationPuzzle carries the spec and route separately. Its validate checks the spec, dimensions, known route gates, the computed solution and each gate’s example proof, but does not compare route uniqueness to the flag.
candidates.conditional_counterexample: Symbolically choose rules version 4; gate_count=2, route_length=2, examples_per_gate=1, minimum_single_example_candidates=1, allow_repeated_operations=false and allow_repeated_route_gates=false. Give Ash the Crown–Hart exchange and Briar the Hart–Moon exchange, with respective examples Crown→Hart and Hart→Moon. Each example uniquely identifies its law among the five operations. With query Crown, route [Ash, Ash] and solution Crown, the two exchanges return Crown, both route gates are known, and all selected length and example checks are satisfied even though the route repeats. This is source reasoning, not an executed puzzle, validator, parser or test.
candidates.native_and_replay_scope: The selected backend challenge view deserializes stored puzzle authority, calls validate and projects it without a replay comparison. The selected challenge submission reducer validates, regenerates from seed and spec, and rejects a replay mismatch; the selected puzzle-lab Replay command likewise validates then compares replay. A malformed stored example satisfying the other view guards could therefore pass the selected validate-only projection path, while the inspected submission path would reject its repeated route. No such stored record, client event or player-visible incident is established.

candidates.safeguards_and_limits: Generation honors the flag, and the inspected submission and CLI replay guards compare regenerated authority. A data-repair, corruption or external input path that persists the symbolic case was not established. Repeated gates are legitimate when the flag is true; the separate allow_repeated_operations policy and duplicate-law questions remain independently open.

Preserve valid repeated routes when enabled, distinct operation policy and existing revision/authorization checks; identify all writers before changing the boundary.
